controls.case: Execute a genuinely alternative participant learner
controls.expected: Actual build/fit/model and complete products admitted; fixed-reference-only orchestrator and artifact-only replay do not establish submitted-method execution.

controls.case: Change source after build, model after fit or target/reference identity
controls.expected: Receipt binding rejects the complete score assembly.

controls.case: Omit difficult rat, optimizer failure, supplement obligation or public query
controls.expected: Full roster retained; invalid_candidate and official family score/gains null.

controls.case: Future bins, centered smoothing, full-trial summary or shared target-test state
controls.expected: Watermark/isolation admission fails; no causal prospective qualification.

controls.case: Cross-arm source or R-outcome exposure to active A/I
controls.expected: Independent contexts prevent transfer; leakage invalidates comparison.

controls.case: Optional argument omitted versus supplied1 with unequal physical group means
controls.expected: Native no-argument absolute branch and active signed branch distinguished; no silently swapped groups.

controls.case: Repeated first-group sample indexes, complement size change and exact null tie
controls.expected: Replacement sampling and complement-of-unique semantics retained; null tie does not count under strict greater-than.

controls.case: High-preferring high-to-mixed rows and low-preferring low-to-mixed rows
controls.expected: Both map to nonpref operand a; pre and post comparisons remain separate; actual trial IDs prove roles.

controls.case: Runs of2,3 and4 consecutive significant bins at interval boundaries
controls.expected: Only complete runs of length>=3 kept; every bin in qualifying run kept; no across-event concatenation.

controls.case: Undefined observed mean and nonfinite null draws
controls.expected: Exact native arithmetic retained with independent undefined-scientific flag; no inferred p-value evidence.

controls.case: One NaN in whole block average beside finite entries and measured zeros
controls.expected: Entire native event/block slice stays initialized zero; provenance distinguishes all default entries from measured zeros.

controls.case: No NaN and separate Inf-only average
controls.expected: No-NaN assignment follows source; Inf is not silently treated as NaN and downstream disposition is retained.

controls.case: Corrected missing-aware tensor presented as native fit input
controls.expected: Native tensor identity/policy mismatch rejected; corrected result only separate declared analysis.

controls.case: Same administrative universe/past but changed future catch, reward, timeout or opt-out assignments
controls.expected: Visible query presence/order/cardinality/fields/identities/schedule and resource metadata unchanged.

controls.case: Return only catch predictions or omit privately unscored rewarded query
controls.expected: Complete public-universe admission fails before private mask join.

controls.case: Documented opt-out, actual100s no-opt-out timeout, missing timestamp and uncertain cap
controls.expected: First observed exact time; second valid observed_restricted_censored100; others unavailable target and complete family unscorable, never imputed100.

controls.case: Negative or >100 prediction and test-outlier removal
controls.expected: Out-of-domain or support mismatch invalidates family; no scorer clipping or denominator shrinkage.

controls.case: One of5 classes absent in one required session×window
controls.expected: Whole decoder family required_unscorable; no four-class macro or session deletion.

controls.case: Current reward/offer/tone information enters decoder from behavior interface
controls.expected: Neural-only view/provenance admission fails; copying labels cannot qualify decoding.

controls.case: One required zero denominator or unbound coordinate map
controls.expected: Full-support ATI and affected full family numeric score null; defined-only mean is diagnostic, not replacement.

controls.case: One failed or omitted case of original200 or substitute toy generator
controls.expected: All200 retained; failed candidate invalidates family; wrong generator rejected; no199-case or toy claim.

controls.case: Ratio-of-means, norm-of-sum or unqualified nonorthogonal gauge
controls.expected: Fails exact ATI contract; sum of separate norms and trained C-SVD algebra required.

controls.case: Median groups, quantile ties or missing Naive ATI
controls.expected: Native strict40/60 tails only; middle/ties explicit; missing ATI cannot masquerade as middle exclusion.

controls.case: Qualified candidate with one missing or failed comparator
controls.expected: Complete absolute score may remain; that gain null and whole-family improvement comparison unscorable; no comparator substitution.

controls.case: Constant/mean/no-history/LDS and shuffled-label comparators
controls.expected: Independent future qualification confirms appropriate units/support and score response, without current empirical claims.

controls.case: Zero post rate after baseline filter, zero pre rate before filter
controls.expected: Native filter, logical linear positions, distance mutation and unchanged rates preserved; source branch frequency not assumed.

controls.case: Mutation affects first or last sorted distance or causes nonmonotone distance order
controls.expected: No native resort/min-max repair; source first:last edges, bins and unbinned/failing cases preserved.

controls.case: Column3 epsilon correction or duration-unit correction hidden in adapter
controls.expected: Native policy mismatch rejected; deliberate corrected analysis has distinct source/method key.

controls.case: Source-native exclusion is mislabeled missing response, or vice versa
controls.expected: Separate inclusion, candidate, target and reference dispositions remain attributable; full component roster retained.

controls.case: One required role/obligation unresolved while assembling whole-paper label
controls.expected: Full-paper readiness/reproduction claim refused; partial diagnostics remain explicitly partial.
